title: 여성의 경제활동 실태조사 등에 관한 규칙 / queue:ADDENDUM:00001:20251001:00002:part:1/1
title_original: 여성의 경제활동 실태조사 등에 관한 규칙
full_text:
Addendum to the Enforcement Rules of the Organization of the Ministry of Gender Equality and Family <Ordinance No. 1, October 1, 2025>

Article 1 (Enforcement Date)
These Rules shall enter into force on the date of their promulgation.

Articles 2 through 5
Omitted.

Article 6 (Amendment of Other Statutes)
(1) through (13) Omitted.
(14) Part of the Rules on Surveys of Women's Economic Activities, etc. shall be amended as follows:
In the portion of Article 2 (1) other than its subparagraphs, subparagraph 6 of the same paragraph, and paragraph (4) of the same Article, the former Korean designation "여성가족부장관" (Minister of Gender Equality and Family) shall in each case be replaced with the new Korean designation "성평등가족부장관" (Minister of Gender Equality and Family).
In the portion of Article 3 other than its subparagraphs, the former Korean designation "여성가족부령" (Ordinance of the Ministry of Gender Equality and Family) shall be replaced with the new Korean designation "성평등가족부령" (Ordinance of the Ministry of Gender Equality and Family).
(15) through (22) Omitted.
